en-US.description: AI office workbench that generates reports, presentations, and more.
en-US.longDescription: OfficeAce is an AI office workbench from Huawei Cloud. It generates professional reports and presentation materials, orchestrates expert-agent debates to reduce hallucinations, and ships more than 30 industry agent templates with office skills for PPT, Word, and Excel. It integrates with Feishu, WeChat Work, DingTalk, and Xiaoyi, with long-term memory, local file organization, and sensitive-data masking.
